definitions.explanation: The position straight underneath something. A written-style word, best known from earthquake terms and from compounds such as {赤道直下|せきどうちょっか} 'right on the equator'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{震源|しんげん}→震源：16060_shingen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直下|ちょっか}だった。
examples.english: The earthquake's focus was directly under the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤道|せきどう}→赤道：04358_sekidou⟧{直下|ちょっか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧。
examples.english: Countries right on the equator are hot all year round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧{直下|ちょっか}⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}している→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I keep water and food ready in case of an earthquake directly under the capital.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直下型地震|ちょっかがたじしん}: an earthquake whose focus is directly under an inhabited area
- ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧{直下|ちょっか}⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧: the long-feared earthquake directly under Tokyo
- {赤道直下|せきどうちょっか}: right on the equator
- {急転直下|きゅうてんちょっか}: a sudden turn of events (four-character idiom)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真下|ました}→真下：07785_mashita⟧: right below; the everyday word
- ⟦{真上|まうえ}→真上：07784_maue⟧: directly above
